name: Reasoning control plane
what: Separate how the planner retrieves, decomposes, branches, selects, compiles, and verifies from the CPCS scene-control data itself; reasoning execution is a control plane above authoring and canonical shot data
use_when: designing any multi-stage prompt planner or agent workflow

name: Adaptive Director Reasoning Graph
what: A typed graph of goals, questions, retrieval, candidates, decisions, transforms, validators, failures, and repairs that orchestrates CoT/least-to-most/ToT/GoT/tool operators according to model capability and decision value
use_when: a directing request crosses performance, motion, camera, format, and model capability

name: Five graph planes
what: Keep knowledge/evidence, scene intent/control, reasoning execution, compilation/realization, and verification/experiments as typed planes that can be projected into one derived graph without mixing their authorities
use_when: expanding graph.json or designing graph storage

name: Decision ledger, not raw chain of thought
what: Store question, alternatives, criteria, scores, selection, evidence, assumptions, confidence, unresolved loss, and validators; do not treat raw private reasoning text as canonical evidence or faithful provenance
use_when: logging planner choices or making decisions retrievable

name: Model-scaled reasoning policy
what: Mini models use fixed narrow DAGs, small retrieval bundles, strict schemas, one responsibility per call, bounded repair, and escalation; larger models may branch and aggregate more while retaining the same compiler and verifier contracts
use_when: choosing how much reasoning or branching to assign to a model

name: Decision-value reasoning router
what: Route low-complexity nodes to direct compile+validate, moderate nodes to least-to-most, high-impact independent alternatives to selective ToT, coupled alternatives to a GoT subgraph, external-state nodes to ReAct, and deterministic computation to code
use_when: allocating reasoning method and budget per decision

name: Selective branch admission
what: Create alternatives only when they change declared axes, preserve hard invariants, are not dominated or duplicate, fit target capabilities, and justify their evaluation cost
use_when: generating design variants without combinatorial prompt bloat

name: Invariant-and-axis variant lattice
what: Define protected invariants, typed variation axes, allowed values, incompatibilities, and maximum simultaneous deltas; measure diversity on semantic deltas rather than wording
use_when: creating intentional video or prompt variants
nl_triggers: keep the idea but vary the camera
different designs without changing the story

name: Graph-aware RAG bundle retrieval
what: Decompose the request into department queries, retrieve typed objects, expand only permitted graph edges, include conflicts and failure cards, rerank by provenance/capability, and return a coverage report rather than one nearest chunk
use_when: retrieving concepts for a multi-domain video request
nl_triggers: get the whole compatible concept bundle

name: Semantic ownership across formats
what: Natural language owns intent and observable description; YAML owns human policy/profiles; JSON owns canonical resolved data; XML owns ordered mixed narrative and namespaced events; JSONL owns append-only evidence. One authoritative source per semantic path per stage
use_when: combining YAML, JSON, XML, and natural-language prompts

name: Compilation loss ledger
what: For every canonical control and target adapter record whether it is native exact, approximate, baked into reference, compressed to text, postprocess-only, evaluation-only, dropped with warning, or unsupported error, including retained and lost information
use_when: compiling a rich CPCS score to a limited video model
nl_triggers: what gets lost in the prompt
model does not support this control

name: Schema-constrained specialist agents
what: Assign one bounded responsibility to mini models, provide a small evidence bundle and output schema, validate externally, repair from precise errors, and escalate rather than hallucinate cross-domain resolution
use_when: using mini or low-cost models in the pipeline

name: Teacher-to-mini decision-pattern distillation
what: Use larger models offline to produce validated concise decision examples or trainable rationale supervision, then deploy smaller specialists with fixed schemas and external checks rather than asking them to perform wide free-form search
use_when: scaling prompt-planning throughput with smaller models
nl_triggers: distill reasoning into a small model
train mini model on director decisions

name: External validation over intrinsic self-critique
what: Use model critique for optional quality refinement, but require parsers, schemas, graph rules, solvers, capability checks, and render metrics for claims about correctness or adherence
use_when: adding a critic or self-refine loop

name: Reasoning-mode ablation
what: Compare direct, local CoT, fixed least-to-most, selective ToT, and ADRG while controlling model, retrieval, formats, candidate policy, target adapter, and verifier; promote only isolated repeatable gains
use_when: testing whether a reasoning architecture actually improves outputs
